title: Retire Default from the theme pickers: New World is the default

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03 17:20Z: "Default doesn't exist. New World is the default theme."

detail: frequency ("Default") joins RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS and leaves THEME_LIBRARY, so the site gallery, editor Theme tab, signed-out wizard and /themes index no longer offer it; /themes/frequency 308s to /themes/new-world and leaves the sitemap. The id, label and every render map stay, so sites that saved it render unchanged. Four pins rewritten on the owner's phrases (2026-11-03 17:55Z): site-style offered themes, the editor Theme tab list, the theme library list, and the create-a-space design-system baseline accepting the Default card's tagline as gone.
